note: Maps spec rows (spec/target-spec.md, T-01..T-30) to committed records. Entries marked supporting_only are displayed without grading the row. A row with no grading entry reads not-yet-measured. Every (record, row) pair signoff/block-manifest.json cites under evidence."5.analog" and evidence."6.analog" must be graded here by an entry citing a file in that same record directory; the generator fails when one is missing, so the manifest is the list of which rows have a record and this file is how each is graded. A row may carry extra entries the manifest does not cite. Grade a row from every record cited for it: one failing record fails the row. Prefer the record's own per-row digest (rows.json, yield.json) over the raw klt sim envelope when the record has one. An entry graded only on a `fail` count passes a row the record merely `reported` (no limits), so grade the record's own `verdict` alongside it. Never edit a spec target to make a row pass. Fields: record (repo path), field (dotted path; [name=X] picks a list item by its name), op (>= <= ==), value or value_field (sibling field of the same record), corner, scope (CH, TC, BOTH or n/a), basis (what the number is), note.

T-15.corner: PVT-FULL, 45 corners, mismatch Monte Carlo (pooled grid)
T-15.note: Simulated, not measured; pre-layout. T-15 passes the 7-sigma gate on the #398 receive split (data lanes on the adopted supply-referenced receiver): mean -1.3 ps, sigma 5.4 ps, sigma-to-spec 10.9 with lower confidence bound 10.4 against 7; no draw outside +-60 ps, worst draw -18.6 ps against the -60 ps limit: mean -1.8 ps, sigma 5.4 ps, sigma-to-spec 10.8 with lower confidence bound 10.3 against 7; no draw outside +-60 ps, worst draw -20.7 ps against the -60 ps limit. Supersedes the failing 2026-11-10 record, which predates the TX predriver NOR widening (89d803b, #164) and the aib_pad_esd XResd l=1u shortening (e47bb80, #332); the two runs also differ in other inputs (the SS and FF diode sections changed from dio_tt to dio_ss and dio_ff in all four requests, and the ngspice engine moved from 46 to 47). The comparison shows the current cells pass under the current setup; it does not isolate how much of the improvement came from the resizes. CH only: the L2 wire-bond loopback does not observe RX-input skew and no TC value is recorded here. The distribution is not normal (Anderson-Darling rejected), so the empirical tail is the quantity read; it is empty out to -20.7 ps. The +-bound / target_sigma 7 convention is sim/mc/README.md's ratification assumption; #136 has not answered otherwise and DR-0019 (#168, unratified) is not depended on. Recorded, not tuned; no limit is relaxed.
